confirmedIssues.title: Snapshot failures/paused sources collapse to empty; absent previous snapshot looks unchanged

confirmedIssues.title: Loaded-page buffer incorrectly labeled last24h; analysis scope not explicit

confirmedIssues.title: Unknown/empty/incomplete evidence declared All FSMs healthy
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Only raw isLoading/fatal gates; empty rows lead universal all-clear; historical loaded page cannot prove current global health.
